evidence: Hor. S. 1.5.4: differtum nautīs, caupōnibus atque malignīs
terms.comment: He keeps a caupōna, an inn or tavern, a trade with a poor name in Horace. A woman who keeps one is a cōpa (Lewis & Short).

phrases.latin: inde Forum Appī, differtum nautīs, caupōnibus atque malignīs
phrases.english: then Forum Appii, crammed with bargemen and grasping innkeepers

sources: Lewis & Short: caupo · Lewis & Short: caupona · Lewis & Short: copa
